newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close firm on quality hunt.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close firm on quality hunt.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed firm on Monday on quality hunt, dealers at the private Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.

There was a general shortage of quality cotton, which mills want to buy for spinning into yarn for export to the Far East where prices of yarn have risen owing to a slight shortage in the year-end holiday season, dealer Nasim Usman said.
In the kerb market, the good quality MNH-93 variety was quoted around 2,600 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), he said.
